sloka: एतत्प्रजानां श्रुत्वा तु प्रजानाथः प्रजापतिः ।कारणादिति चोक्त्वासौ प्रजाः पुनरभाषत ।। ७.३५.५७ ॥
transliteration: etatprajānāṁ śrutvā tu prajānāthaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।kāraṇāditi coktvāsau prajāḥ punarabhāṣata ।। 7.35.57 ॥

translations.english: Having heard this from the people, Prajapati, the lord of creation, then spoke to them again, saying "due to the reason."
